name: com.pixygon.quarry
description: Bring Thread worlds and Quarry models into Unity. Imports a World Manifest (world.json from `thread level`) — its glb assets, prefab materials and placements — into a scene, and keeps the provenance (Codex slug, Quarry design, recipe) on every object so an asset can always be traced back to the canon that produced it. Ships the Grove Wind shader, which reads the four wind channels every Grove plant carries and moves trees the moment they land in a scene.
